FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 482
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Mike Shaw
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/08/2025
House Bill 482 as introduced would allow the State Treasurer to invest certain state funds in
digital assets, under certain conditions.
This bill would increase the obligations of the State Treasurer to implement the provisions of
this bill.
